And, if possible, I’d like to update my default shipping address to my daughter’s address in Chicago so I don’t have to change it every time.

(If you prefer, tell me your **first name, last name, and ZIP code** instead.)

Also, to look up tracking and the tablet details:
2) **What is your order ID** (it looks like `#W0000000`)?  
3) For the tablet: do you know the **product name/model** or the **storage size** you’re expecting (e.g., 64GB / 128GB / 256GB)?

- verify the **storage size** of the tablet you ordered,

Is there any way you can look up my recent orders with my name and ZIP code? I’d really appreciate your help. By the way, thanks for being patient with me—sometimes I get a bit forgetful these days.

As for my daughter’s address, I’ll have to look it up and give it to you in a moment. Sorry, my memory isn’t what it used to be! I really appreciate you helping me sort all this out. It’s nice to have someone to talk to, honestly.
